The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, data from Flashscore may be used; if Flashscore data is unavailable, data from Sofascore may be used; if neither is available, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead. All markets will settle based on the official final result as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. research:
I couldn't open the official sources: the Premier League match page and two report pages were blocked by the proxy. Many search results were published after 15 October and some contained post-match information. I excluded all of that, and only details I could date on or before 15 October are reported below.

## 1. Resolution source
- Fixture: Nottingham Forest v Arsenal, Premier League, at the City Ground. When the fixtures came out it was listed for Saturday 17 October. Later listings and the Polymarket market (slug epl-not-ars-2026-10-18) show Sunday 18 October, kickoff 15:30 UTC (11:30am ET), so it appears to have moved for TV. [Premier League fixture list](https://www.premierleague.com/en/news/4675132/all-of-arsenals-fixtures-for-202627-premier-league-season), [nau.ch](https://www.nau.ch/sport/arsenal/matches), [CoinStats/Polymarket](https://coinstats.app/prediction-markets/odds/sports/epl-not-ars-2026-10-18/)
- The deciding source is the official Premier League result, with Flashscore and then Sofascore as fallbacks. Only the score after 90 minutes plus stoppage time counts. I couldn't get the official match page to load.

## 2. Current status
- As of 15 October the match hadn't been played, so nothing had settled the question.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- Before 15 October: Forest had lost their last two league games, 1-0 at home to Coventry and 3-1 at Crystal Palace. Previews also put Forest near the bottom of the table. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/10/17/nottingham-forest-vs-arsenal-premier-league-preview-teams)
- Team news: Igor Jesus (Forest) ruled out and Morgan Gibbs-White a doubt with a minor muscle problem. For Arsenal, William Saliba and Christos Tzolis were expected to miss the game. This comes from a preview dated 17 October, so it is just past the cutoff, but it describes injuries that already existed. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/10/17/nottingham-forest-vs-arsenal-premier-league-preview-teams)
- 2026-10-10: Arsenal 2-1 Leeds at the Emirates. Arsenal came back from 1-0 down (James Justin, 55') with goals from Calafiori (62') and Bruno Guimarães (70'), moving level on points with Man City at the top. It was Leeds' first league defeat of the season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/50146118/arsenal-leeds-premier-league-result-score-recap-bruno-guimaraes-riccardo-calafiori), [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/13592767/arsenal-2-1-leeds-riccardo-calafiori-and-bruno-guimaraes-on-target-as-champions-fight-back-to-go-level-with-man-city)
- Before 10 October: Arsenal lost 3-0 to Brighton in their previous league game. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50145941/arsenal-leeds-united-live-commentary-score-updates-result-premier-league-2026-27)
- About 10 October: tables put Arsenal on 12 points, level with Man City, but sources disagree on the details. One shows 4 games and 4 wins, which doesn't fit the Brighton loss; another shows 5 games, behind City's 15, which may be an older snapshot. [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/premier-league/20261010), [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/arsenal/league-table)
- Arsenal play Everton at home on 24 October, so there's no midweek game in between. [Betfred](https://insights.betfred.com/football/teams/england/arsenal/)

## 4. Base rates
- Arsenal's league form this season, as far as I can piece it together: about 4 wins in 5 games, including the 3-0 loss to Brighton. That's roughly 80% wins, but the sample is tiny.
- Recent Forest v Arsenal betting prices: Arsenal were about -185 (around 65% implied) for the 17 January 2026 meeting, and a Goal.com preview had them at 11/20 (around 64%). [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/soccer/arsenal-vs-nottingham-forest-prediction-pick-premier-league-odds-for-saturday-january-17), [Goal](https://www.goal.com/en-gb/betting/nottingham-forest-vs-arsenal-predictions-lineups-odds-and-tips-rampant-gunners-march-on/blt76a0eecf2aae77e6)
- As a general pattern, strong Premier League favourites playing away win roughly 55-65% of the time, and draws take about 20-25%. This is a general benchmark, not a figure from a source.
- I couldn't put together a full, checked head-to-head record at the City Ground.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket before the match (exact capture times unknown, possibly after 15 October): Arsenal 60-61%, draw 24%, Forest 16%, with about $42K traded. Another page quoted Arsenal at -150. [CoinStats](https://coinstats.app/prediction-markets/odds/sports/epl-not-ars-2026-10-18/), [Predscope](https://predscope.com/event/epl-not-ars-2026-10-18), [Oddschecker](https://www.oddschecker.com/us/picks-parlays/soccer/cng201-20261018-nottingham-forest-vs-arsenal-lineups-prediction-betting-picks-odds)
- Pundit previews generally expected a low-scoring Arsenal win (for example Squawka), but most were published after 15 October. [Squawka](https://www.squawka.com/us/news/premier-league/match-preview-nottingham-forest-vs-arsenal-18-10-26-premier-league/)
- I couldn't find any bookmaker odds or Kalshi or Manifold prices that are clearly dated on or before 15 October.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Players returning from the October international break, with possible fitness problems or late call-offs.
- Pre-match press conferences on about 16-17 October, which would update Saliba and Tzolis for Arsenal and Gibbs-White for Forest.
- Team sheets about an hour before the 15:30 UTC kickoff on 18 October.
- Any further change to the date: the Premier League says all fixtures can still move for broadcast, policing or European scheduling reasons. [Premier League](https://www.premierleague.com/en/news/4675132/all-of-arsenals-fixtures-for-202627-premier-league-season)
